verdict_per_rule.R2_product_agreement_at_chance: FALSE per the frozen rule (default mode cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5_174k: observed weighted 0.3588 vs shuffled null 0.3452 (std 4.1e-05) => z=329, genuinely above chance, matching the harness's own r2_default_purity_weighted_at_chance=False). BUT: ARI_branch 0.0072 and NMI_area 0.0333 on that default mode are near-zero (macro-alignment essentially absent), and full_text_tfidf_light is exactly AT chance (weighted 0.3452 == null mean, p_emp 0.23; z=0.38). Interpretation: the join scramble destroys macro structure (NMI_area 0.013-0.033 vs 0.555-0.574 in truth) while leaving a residual micro-signal; R2_weak_but_above_chance=True from the historical harness is consistent.
verdict_per_rule.R3_source_driven: TRUE with fine ARI_branch < 0.10 (0.0430 / 0.0441 / 0.0469) AND coarse ARI_branch 0.2581 / 0.1747 / 0.1629. Accepted purity >= 0.85 reproduced on all 3 text modes on evaluation embeddings (0.9301 / 0.9057 / 0.9089; EXACT matches to accepted artifacts) while product artifacts are < 0.60 or absent. IMPORTANT granularity correction: the frozen R3 rule's 'micro-pure/macro-unaligned' label applies to the FINE over-segmented level (365-1316 clusters); at the COARSE level the same hierarchy shows weak-to-moderate recapture of the 5-class branch axis (coarse ARI 0.16-0.26), not ~0.04.
verdict_per_rule.falsification_clause: PARTIALLY TRIGGERED as a scientific characterization on the FINE level, NOT as falsification of the accepted headline: R3 eval-embedding hierarchies are micro-coherent and DO recapture legal_area structure (NMI_area 0.555-0.574, ~40x the product artifacts' 0.013-0.033); the coarse partition shows weak-to-moderate branch recapture (coarse ARI_branch 0.16-0.26) while the fine partition does not (fine ARI_branch ~0.04). The accepted 0.906-0.930 fine_purity claims are REPRODUCED (bit-exact) but, under the frozen positive control, they are NOT a validated branch-recovery claim.

headline_status.supported_statement: The accepted hierarchical_v1 unweighted fine_branch_purity 0.906-0.930 is bit-exactly reproducible on the evaluation-v25 embeddings with the frozen run_hierarchical_v1 pipeline. That is a metric-level reproduction only.
not_supported: That the TF-IDF hierarchical modes recover the human branch taxonomy: the frozen EVAL_SPEC positive control fails (fine ARI_branch 0.0429 < 0.05) even on source-corrected labels.
That fine_branch_purity 0.906-0.930 implies macro (5-class) branch alignment: the metric is fragmentation-inflated at the fine level (fine ARI_branch ~0.04; coarse ARI_branch 0.16-0.26).
That the product_integration_174k artifacts are servable: they are id-scrambled (join probe diag_is_best=0.0).
headline_status.prior_label_retracted: The audited verdict used the unqualified term 'CONFIRMED' for the headline and attributed the discrepancy entirely to the product join defect. Both are narrowed here (audit required_fixes F2).

root_cause.mechanism: METADATA_PATH=/tmp/lex_accepted/evaluation/evaluation/data/174k/metadata_174k.json (173963, eval order); EMBEDDINGS_DIR=results/fractal_map/hierarchical_map_174k/legal_tfidf_embeddings (175440, corpus-jsonl order); embeddings[:n_meta] positional truncation with NO row-order verification; decision_clusters[metadata[i].decision_id] = labels[i]. Row order mismatch (proven by join probe) therefore scrambles the id->cluster mapping.
root_cause.why_accepted_was_truthful: Accepted verdicts (hierarchical_v1_174k_tfidf/*.json, 0.906-0.930) were computed by fractal_map/evaluation/run_hierarchical_v1_174k_tfidf.py on the EVAL-aligned v25 suite embeddings (row i = metadata row i), so their row space IS the id space.
root_cause.prior_evidence: Census audit run 36035695081 already REJECTED row-order alignment for the 174k builds (legal_distance_modes/alignment_probe_v26.json: candidate_agreement 0.426 vs ~1.0 expected); zoom_quality_174k_all_modes_v26.py flagged the 174k build as placeholder-keyed and separately BLOCKED.
root_cause.defect_class: Data-integrity / join-alignment defect in product artifacts.
root_cause.scope_correction: This defect is A cause of the product-artifact vs accepted-headline numeric gap and it fully explains the product id-scrambling. It is NOT the only cause of the overall discrepancy: independently of the join defect, the frozen agreement harness fails its own positive control on source-corrected labels (fine ARI_branch 0.0429 < 0.05), so the harness does not establish branch recovery for ANY TF-IDF hierarchical mode (audit required_fix F2).

blockers_raised.message: product_integration_174k decision_clusters.json/labels are built from the 175440-row product embedding matrix positionally truncated to 173963 and keyed to eval metadata ids without row-order verification; the mapping is scrambled (join probe: diag_is_best=0.0 for all 3 text modes; product purity at chance). Rebuild product artifacts from eval-aligned embeddings (v25 suite, 173963 rows in metadata order) or regenerate product embeddings in metadata order, then re-run the join probe (expect diag_is_best ~1.0) before product promotion.
